brief:
Palestinians in Gaza face a daily struggle to secure bread, food, medicine, and basic necessities beyond the immediate threat of bombardment and destruction, Shehab Wire reported. Three years into the conflict, citizens confront a compounded crisis as occupation forces, border crossings, and traders restrict access to essential supplies.

The humanitarian emergency has expanded from a military conflict into an economic siege, with Gazans caught between military devastation and systemic deprivation of resources required for survival.

title: Gazans battle blockade, merchants, and occupation for survival
